kind: owner executor image build, real offline container fixture, and production configuration activation
reason: The development image lacked ssh-keygen, which prevented the real deploy-key creation and recovery test from running during Praxis self-validation.

build.recipe:
FROM sha256:a807793c27f53bf93480fc3dcfe73b2ab1b6bdf8b3aa1aca820118fd43767170
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssh-client && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
build.recipeScope: Private owner overlay; no tracked image recipe or self-update workspace files were changed.
build.reproducibility: The exact base image must already exist in the rootless image store. Package repositories were not snapshot-pinned, so later builds may resolve different package versions. The tested digest identifies the resulting image used here.
build.packageNetwork: Package installation used the base image's configured Debian repositories during this owner build.

offlineFixture.kind: actual rootless container; direct runtime fixture, not authenticated MCP

firstAttempt.result: Fixture assertion error; original failure evidence preserved.
firstAttempt.failure: Python Path.exists raised PermissionError while checking an inaccessible protected directory.
firstAttempt.correction: A separate fixture attempt used a readability check that treats denied access as inaccessible. Its package-version query also avoided service-manager environment expansion.

activation.kind: owner maintenance on the production coding service

preservation.baseline: Fresh online SQLite backups and metadata captured immediately before this image-only activation.
